title: ISP Billing System
projectDescription: A comprehensive ISP Management and Billing platform designed to streamline operations for Internet Service Providers. It handles automated client provisioning, subscription management, payment tracking, and network integration with MikroTik routers.
challengesOvercome: Designing a system that could securely and instantly provision PPPoE profiles on network hardware upon successful payment required complex asynchronous job processing and robust error handling to prevent service interruptions.
architectureDecisions: Built a scalable React front-end to provide administrators with a real-time dashboard. The backend architecture utilizes secure APIs to communicate directly with ISP hardware (MikroTik OLTs/Routers) while maintaining strict data consistency for financial transactions.

title: Space Travelers Hub
projectDescription: Eventify is web application that allows users to create, view, and manage events. Users can create an event by providing details such as the event name, location, date, and time. Users can also delete events they no longer want to host.
challengesOvercome: Managing complex state across multiple nested components required implementing a robust Redux store. Additionally, ensuring the backend API could handle concurrent event creations required optimizing database indexing and query structures.
architectureDecisions: Chose React with Redux for state management on the front-end to ensure predictable state updates. The backend is powered by Ruby on Rails, providing a rapid development environment with built-in security features and MVC architecture.
keyFeatures: Responsive design for mobile and desktop
